text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're definitely going to the
Japan Cup,
right?
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
Duh! It's a direct showdown between
Rudolf and
Brian! I wouldn't miss it!
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
What?! We can't do any interviews this
week?!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid we're rather overwhelmed with

interview requests this week.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
On top of that, we've had to take extra
measures
to address people entering the
campus without
permission, so it's
getting more difficult to grant

permission for interviews.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text: Oh, I see...
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Hey, who do you think will win? It's
gotta be
President Rudolf, right?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
It's hard to say... Why don't we watch
and see?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
We'll bear witness to the moment when
the title
of greatest ever changes hands!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Are people really that worked up about
the
outcome?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We're both going to reach greater
heights. Next
time we race... I won't lose.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Then... until "the time comes," as you
said.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...The time has come.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(The gates are definitely going to be full
at the
race. There are going to be a lot
of other racers
besides me.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: (And she'll be among them.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(We'll all line up at the gates. Me. Her.
And
then...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Gasp! Huff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...The same time again?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан suddenly stops running in
the middle
of training for the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин was strong. So was
Mihono
Bourbon. And Огури Кэп too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: But Симболи Рудольф was even stronger.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Am I wrong?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I was able to compete against racers of

incomparable skill in both the spring
Tenno Sho
and the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's why I understand their strength.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And Rudolf, sitting on her throne as
Emperor, was
especially outstanding.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I don't think the results of that race
would change
even now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Every time I repeat that match in my
head, the
picture becomes more clear.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The wall that surrounds the Emperor is
massive
and imposing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...It might be reckless to go beyond it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's legs tremble slightly as she
says
that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Haha...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What if I told you that's not it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What if the truth is that... I'm actually
scared?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've never seen her like this before.
Нарита Брайан is
nervous.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: If anyone can do it, it's you!

text_block_list.text: What if I lose?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hah. Geez...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, this all started
when...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This is racing. The first across the finish
line wins,
right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
You're going to win, no matter who you're up
against!

text_block_list.text: ...Don't try and make me say that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Haha... Idiot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Ever since that time, you—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. You probably don't even

remember.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...You big dummy.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The next day, there's a press conference
in the
lead up to the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф is the first to arrive. As
for Narita
Brian...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, is Brian not coming?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me she decided to withdraw.
There's no
way...
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
No, it's definitely possible. She lost that

scrimmage against Rudolf, after all.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр C

text_block_list.text: Ka-thump!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...You're late.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Sorry, I forgot something.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I forgot to tell you directly that I'm
going to beat
you this time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me... Brian, did you just say
that—
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
I will overcome the Emperor in the Japan
Cup
without a doubt.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's a bold claim! She's not even

considering the possibility of losing?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
This is headline material! Hurry up and
get
working on a special feature!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр C

text_block_list.text: ...There is no going back now.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I never had any intention of turning
back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Is that so?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...It is.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан and Симболи Рудольф line up
beside
each other and hold out their
hands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's only a short while left before
their
showdown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
